units.source_text: “他自己好像不知道是在吃饭，我说，

en.t: "He himself seemed not to know that he was eating, I said,

units.source_text: 那样不易消化，吃饭不专心，恐怕对身体不好吧。

en.t: eating like that would not be easy to digest, and if he did not pay attention to his meal, it would probably be bad for his health.

units.source_text: 他拉长脸，又直勾勾地凝望虚空了。”

en.t: He pulled a long face and once again stared fixedly into empty space."
